deadline.value: Applications are open all year, but apply by January 31, 2027 for September 2027 entry to be considered for scholarships.
deadline.quote: Applications for the MES and PhD programs are open all year. | To be considered for a scholarship, completed applications should be received by the following dates: | Start Term Application Deadline September January 31

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You must secure a SENS supervisor (with written support) before applying; applications without one are incomplete.
supervisor.quote: Applicants must contact SENS faculty and secure a supervisor before submitting your application. | Applicants who do not secure a supervisor will not be considered, and the application will be deemed incomplete.

funding.value: Funding is scholarship-based; you need at least 80% in your last two years to be considered.
funding.quote: To be considered for potential scholarship funding, students must have obtained at least 80% in the last two years of undergraduate or graduate study.

entry_route.value: A relevant master's degree (70%+) is required for the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Master's degree, or equivalent, from a recognized university in a relevant academic discipline
